title: "The whole thing's broken" — cascading failure
backstory: A cabinet that's been sitting in a garage for 10 years. Everything looks wrong. The picture is dim and rolling, there's a hum from the speaker, and random garbage tiles appear on screen. Where do you even start?
visible_effect: Rolling dark band from sync fault + dim overlay from PSU + stuck tile in VRAM + audio hum in test tone
diagnosis_hint: Start with the PSU. A 800 mV ripple on the 5 V rail will cause every downstream symptom. Replace the main filter caps (4 × 4700 µF, 16 V) on the PSU board first. Once power is clean, the other symptoms often resolve or become easier to isolate.
